answer.summary: Family plan confirmed for Pancho Libre's 21:00 set on 2027-07-31 at the Maritime Museum stage (confirmed listing l02 v2): show starts 21:00 and ends 21:35. Access was reserved through the festival access desk (receipt R-0007): three free seated step-free places for Wei, Mei and Lila, viewing platform opens 20:30 with check-in deadline 20:45, fee 0 CAD. The step-free bus-L route (receipt R-0005) was confirmed step-free on every leg: outbound 20:00-20:20, eight-minute walk to stage, standing stretches at most seven minutes, return bus departs 21:50 after an eight-minute walk, arriving 22:10 with a five-minute walk home (home arrival 22:15, within the 22:15 deadline). Round-trip bus fare is 18 CAD for the family; full plan cost is 108 CAD (admission 0 + transport 18 + food 60 + contingency 30), within the 360 CAD cap; no payment taken. Minor-accompaniment confirmation WA-0731 was issued by the welfare desk confirming the 8-year-old Lila Chen is accompanied by Wei Chen and Mei Chen for the 21:00 set. All constraints met: no stairs, walking segments and standing stretches within limits, confirmed seats, no alcohol package.
